subject: FY 2017 Municipal and School Budget
overview: The Medford City Council approved the $162.1 million FY 2017 municipal and school budget following lengthy debate over school security, staffing, and transparency. The council also addressed airplane noise complaints, Board of Appeals notice rules, and an ordinance to track university off-campus housing.

items.title: Commendation of Medford High School Boys Crew Team
items.summary: The council commended the Medford High School boys crew team for winning the GBL title and state silver medal.

items.title: Newburn Avenue Signage
items.summary: Referred a request to the Traffic Commission for larger, eye-level one-way and Do Not Enter signs on Newburn Avenue.

items.title: Board of Appeals Abutter Notification Radius
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the Board of Appeals notify all property owners within 300 feet of a subject property.

items.title: Airplane Noise Update
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution seeking an administration update on low-flying airplane noise and inviting the city's Massport representative to an upcoming meeting.

items.title: University Off-Campus Housing Accountability Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance requiring colleges to collect and submit data on off-campus student housing to the Ad Hoc Committee on Education.

items.title: Routine Infrastructure Requests and Recognitions
items.summary: Approved routine resolutions addressing heavy trucking signs, crosswalk painting, pothole repairs, street sweeping, park lights, and local anniversaries.

items.title: FY 2017 Municipal and School Budget
items.summary: Approved the amended $162,108,545 FY 2017 budget after debate on school security, administrative transparency, capital planning, and staffing levels.

items.title: FY 2016 Year-End Transfers and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved FY 2016 year-end financial transfers and approved past meeting minutes.
